abilities.name: Aura of Mercy
abilities.description: Allies in the aura gain a +2 status bonus to saves against fear, emotion, and mental effects. Enemies in the aura take a –1 status penalty to damage rolls. Any creature that reduces an ally to 0 HP in the aura must succeed at a DC 22 Will save or be stunned 1.

abilities.name: Forgiveness First
abilities.description: The teacher declares forgiveness upon a willing creature within 30 ft. The target is freed from all guilt-based mental effects (including confusion, domination, and fear from moral injury), regains 2d8+10 HP, and gains a +2 status bonus to Will saves for 1 round. This is a divine, emotion, mental, healing effect.

abilities.name: Authority to Heal
abilities.trigger: The teacher or an ally within 30 ft. successfully uses Forgiveness First or casts a heal spell on a living creature.
abilities.description: The target also ends one condition of the teacher's choice: paralyzed, slowed, stunned, or restrained. The teacher says: 'Which is easier?' — the condition ends as divine authority overrides the affliction.

abilities.name: Open the Roof
abilities.trigger: An ally within 60 ft. attempts a skill check to overcome a physical or social barrier (locked door, crowded room, sealed border, hostile crowd).
abilities.description: The teacher speaks a word of permission. The ally rolls twice and takes the better result. If the barrier was maintained by an opposing will (a guard, a ward, a bureaucratic rule), that will must succeed at a DC 24 Will save or the barrier simply ceases to function for 1 round.

abilities.name: Teaching Without Walls
abilities.description: The teacher does not require a deity's sanction to forgive or heal. Effects that would suppress divine magic (antimagic fields, divine interdiction, anathema violations) do not affect the teacher's spells or abilities. The teacher's power comes from *mercy itself*, not institutional authority.
